title: Monad
description: JSON Schema for a monad on a category C — an endofunctor T : C → C equipped with a unit natural transformation η : Id_C ⇒ T and a multiplication natural transformation μ : T² ⇒ T satisfying associativity and unit laws (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. VI; Eilenberg & Moore 1965). Specializes functor by adding the unit and multiplication cells. unevaluatedProperties: false locks the leaf surface.

endofunctor.description: The endofunctor T : C → C that this monad is structured on. Source-category and target-category of the endofunctor are equal.

unit.description: The unit natural transformation η : Id_C ⇒ T.

multiplication.description: The multiplication natural transformation μ : T² ⇒ T.
